Hi Tom — thanks for the note and for sending the form. Quick answers up front, then proposed next steps.

Summary answers:
- Active tenant data & embeddings: we can remove PII and perform full deletion of customer data tied to the tenant ID. Standard timeline for hosted customers is ~30 calendar days from confirmed request.
- Application logs/telemetry: application logs that include request-level info are retained ~30 days; audit logs are retained 90 days by default (we can export longer if needed).
- Backups/snapshots: periodic snapshots may exist outside the active DB; our default snapshot retention window can be 90–180 days depending on the underlying storage provider. Those backups are treated as immutable in the short term, so full purge from backups can be delayed unless you opt into an expedited purge.
- Data residency: your tenant is in us-east-1. We do not replicate to outside regions unless configured.

Attachments: redwood-rtbf-overview.pdf (high-level process + SLAs).

Proposed next steps:
1) Please confirm the exact tenant ID(s) and sample record IDs you want removed.
2) We will open an internal RTBF ticket and begin active-data deletion.
3) If you require backup purge within a tighter window, we can provide a quote for expedited purge (engineering + storage vendor ops).
4) Schedule a short call to align on scope — Thurs 3/24 10:00–11:00 PT works for us; happy to move.

I'll loop in Lauren and Marcus for any contractual or procurement implications.

Best,
